## Decisions

Architecture decisions in force. Before calling behaviour a bug, ask `bin/gotdocs why "<what you observed>"` - it searches what each record explains, which is deliberately not reproduced here.

- **0001-docs-live-in-the-repo** - Docs are markdown files in the working tree under configured roots, versioned by git, with no external wiki, database or hosted service in the loop.  ·  `decisions/0001-docs-live-in-the-repo.md`
- **0002-python-stdlib-only-cli** - gotdocs ships as source inside the repo it guards, imports nothing outside the Python 3.9 stdlib, and its sh shim exits 0 rather than blocking a commit when python is missing.  ·  `decisions/0002-python-stdlib-only-cli.md`
- **0003-covers-globs-as-the-staleness-signal** - A doc is impacted when a changed code path matches one of its hand-declared covers globs; there is no content diffing, no LLM judgement and no import graph in the check path.  ·  `decisions/0003-covers-globs-as-the-staleness-signal.md`
- **0004-ci-records-debt-instead-of-blocking** - enforce.pre_commit, pre_push and ci all default to warn; findings are written to a tracked debt ledger on push to main, and only the stale committed index fails a pull request.  ·  `decisions/0004-ci-records-debt-instead-of-blocking.md`
- **0005-restricted-yaml-frontmatter-subset** - Only scalars, quoted scalars, inline flow lists and block lists of scalars are accepted; anything else is a located error, and the writer rewrites only updated and verified_at.  ·  `decisions/0005-restricted-yaml-frontmatter-subset.md`
- **0006-verify-stamp-as-the-escape-hatch** - An impacted doc is satisfied by editing it or by running gotdocs verify, which stamps verified_at with the head sha and updated with today's date into the tracked file.  ·  `decisions/0006-verify-stamp-as-the-escape-hatch.md`
- **0007-symptoms-routing-for-intent-lookup** - gotdocs why ranks decision records by weighted token overlap against a hand-written symptoms list, so an agent can ask is this intentional before treating behaviour as a bug.  ·  `decisions/0007-symptoms-routing-for-intent-lookup.md`
- **0008-index-first-context-economy** - Agents read .gotdocs/INDEX.md first and open only what they need; the file is one line per document, excludes symptoms and bodies, and is committed and byte-reproducible.  ·  `decisions/0008-index-first-context-economy.md`
